Messages.Author: John (Droz) Ferretti
Messages.Body:
If a player that has Millicent Smith, Puritan Vampire Hunter is ousted is
Millicent Smith, Puritan Vampire Hunter also gone or dose it move to the
predator

Messages.Author: davey!
Messages.Body:



When you are ousted, all cards you control are burned. This applies to
Millicent, since "having" her actually means you control her. She would
be placed in her owner's ash heap, or if her owner is already ousted she
is returned to that player.

-davey!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Card text (VTES) on Millicent uses "control" explicitly:
"At the end of your turn, your predator takes control of Millicent."
